package billing

import "testing"

// A test may clean up its own fixture rows and insert directly.
func TestCleanup(t *testing.T) {
	_ = `DELETE FROM charges WHERE org_id = $1`
	_ = `UPDATE credit_ledger SET note = 'x'`
	_ = `INSERT INTO charges (id) VALUES ($1)`
	type Bad struct{ AmountMinor float64 }
}
